q=quotes[~quotes.not_quoted]
q=q.assign(Vendor=q.vendor.map(names))
g=q.groupby('Vendor').agg(lines=('rm_code','count'),with_history=('otif',lambda s:s.notna().sum()),OTIF=('otif','mean'),Defect=('defect_rate','mean'),claim_otif=('otif_claim_pct','mean'),claim_def=('defect_claim_pct','mean')).reset_index()
g['OTIF']=(g.OTIF*100).round(1);g['Defect']=(g.Defect*100).round(2)
g['claim_otif']=g.claim_otif.round(1);g['claim_def']=g.claim_def.round(2)
g['Status']=g.OTIF.apply(lambda x:'No history' if x!=x else 'Good' if x>=95 else 'Low')
result=g
